title: Mechanistic Anomaly Detection on Novel-Input Distributions

original_idea.body:
# MAD on Novel-Input Distributions

Reuse quirky-model MAD; vary distributional distance, measure how AUROC degrades.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: MAD on novel inputs is precisely ARC's open anomaly-detection problem.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Reuses quirky-model MAD setup with simple detectors; clear inherited methodology.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected ARC monitoring problem, no internal access, benefits external scrutiny.

novelty.reasoning: MAD is studied; OOD-degradation mapping of the detector may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: MAD exists; the novel-input degradation mapping may be open.
